en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Introduction to the basic characteristics of ornamental woody plants and flowers. Basics of growing technologies, propagation, growing, realization of cultivated plants, the basic assortment.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction to ornamental nursery (allowance 2/2) a.Basic concepts, present condition and perspective of ornamental nursery in the CR and abroad.b.Conditions for nursery production (soil, climate, structure and equipment of ornamental nurseries).2.Basics of propagation of ornamental trees (allowance 6/6) a.generative propagation of woody plants (dividing, used technologies)b.vegetative propagation of woody plant (dividing, used technologies)3.Trees grown in a nursery by the growing groups, open ground production, container production (allowance 6/6) a.broadleaves and evergreensb.conifersc.Harvesting, sorting, packing, expedition and storage of woody plants4.Introduction to floriculture (allowance 2/2) a.Distribution and significance of flowers, present state of floriculture in the CZ and abroad.b.Soil and climatic conditions for flower production, nutritional requirements, protection, the growing conditions in the open ground production and greenhouse production, growing areas5.Propagation and flower production, breeding (allowance 6/6) a.Rozmnožování květin, požadavky na odrůdy, šlechtěníb.flowers propagation, requirements on varieties, breedingc.Growing procedures - sowing, planting, nursing, harvesting, post-harvest treatment and care of flowers6.Flowers assortment (allowance 6/6) a.Flowers for outdoor placements (annuals, biennials, perennials, bulbs and tubers).b.Flowers grown under glass and in pots, cut flowers, pot flowers.c.Basic principles of flower arranging, floristics.
